name: Server Card
summary: A grid of host cards, each with its name, region, provider, status, specs and CPU, memory and disk meters that turn amber and red as they fill.
useWhen: An infrastructure page that shows each host's health and how full its resources are
A capacity review where a few hosts need attention and the rest should read as fine at a glance
avoidWhen: Hundreds of hosts or a sortable list, where a data table fits better
Service uptime history or incidents, where operations/status-02 or operations/status-05 fits better
